title: Concertino
identity: Bob Mintzer's *Concertino* is an original three-movement work published by Advance Music as ADV40003, arranged for alto saxophone and piano. Schott/Advance describes a blend of orchestral vocabulary with Latin, jazz, and American folk groove-oriented music, labels it medium advanced, and lists 28 pages. The official seven-page preview labels the solo part concert pitch.

evidence.claim: Schott/Advance identifies the alto saxophone and piano edition, three-movement design, stylistic description, medium-advanced designation, and 28-page score.

Inspected score preview: page 1 labels the solo saxophone part concert pitch, gives Allegro Moderato (quarter note approximately 120), shows a largely long-note/slurred saxophone line over a repeated bass and chord pattern, with several written '1x tacet' cues. Page 4 is headed movement II; it opens with saxophone rests, then combines sustained notes, denser piano chords, and later short-note saxophone figures. Preview comprises seven pages and is incomplete.

score_observations.claim: Page 1 is explicitly marked Concert Pitch and Allegro Moderato (quarter note approximately 120); the saxophone has a predominantly sustained/slurred opening line, while piano bass/chord figures recur and several measures are marked '1x tacet.' Page 4, movement II, begins with rests in the saxophone, then shows sustained entries over denser chordal piano writing and later short-note saxophone figures. These are features of the preview only.

review_focus: Inference from the inspected excerpts and publisher description: assess contrast between the sustained/slurred opening and denser second-movement entries, and verify groove/style changes across the full part. The preview is incomplete.
collection_flag: Original professional-composer work in an alto saxophone and piano reduction; publisher labels it medium advanced. No youth-transcription context found.

score_links.description: Official seven-page preview of the score and part; pages 1 and 4 inspected. The preview labels the saxophone part concert pitch.

gaps: Publisher preview is only seven pages of the 28-page edition; full score, remaining movement contrast, and complete saxophone range are unknown.
No saxophone recording was opened or auditioned. The publisher's separate play-along product is not verified here.
